checks.check: keyboard-only create, status, save, search and recent navigation work with character shortcuts disabled
picker ignores synthetic composition and modified text keys before ordinary keyboard selection
private-team revocation removes a real recent issue title and excludes it from search
milestones persist outcomes, keyboard order and scoped assignment, then safely detach on deletion
milestone conflicts retain the typed draft and require a review of the saved version
milestone loading and connection failure remain recoverable without fake empty counts
cycle creation keeps DST calendar boundaries, rejects overlap and preserves a conflicting draft
live cycle scope follows completed work while daily snapshots remain immutable across recapture and reload
cycle closure preserves issue state, accessible history and explicit conflict-aware carry-forward
project creation and brief edits persist while metadata and body versions remain independent
project scope excludes canceled, archived and deleted work while completion and updates preserve issue facts
stale project metadata drafts are reviewed without overwriting an independently saved brief
competing project brief editors retain the rejected draft until an explicit reviewed save
project brief references and file bytes persist while revision selection remains read-only and keyboard accessible

limitations: Synthetic composition events do not qualify a real OS IME.
Native desktop, assistive technology, physical keyboard layouts and screenshot review remain separate gates.
artifacts: No auth state, trace, video, screenshot, request headers or HTTP bodies are published.
